title.en: Polite requests with ください

summary.en: Pair a verb's て-form with ください to ask someone warmly and politely to do something.

body.en:
From *ひだまり旅館*, season 1.

One of the most useful patterns at any Japanese inn or shop is the verb 'て'-form followed by *ください* ('please do...'). When Mio asks Kenji *大事なことを全部教えてください* ('please teach me everything important'), *教えて* comes from *教える* ('teach, tell').

Adding *どうぞ* ('please, go right ahead') at the start makes invitations extra welcoming, as in *どうぞ座ってください* ('please have a seat') from *座る* ('sit'). In moments of surprise, you will also hear *待ってください* ('please wait!') from *待つ* ('wait').
